title: Plain Cheesecake (Classic No Bake)
description: No-bake simplicity at its finest — smooth, sweet, and forever dependable. A real fridge-set classic.

ingredients.notes: see geletine booming guide in reference tab

method.instruction: Crush the Butternut Snap cookies to fine crumbs. Combine with melted butter and press firmly into the base of a springform tin. Refrigerate while preparing the filling.
Measure out 10 g of powdered gelatine. Sprinkle evenly over 60 ml of cold water. Let stand for 5–10 minutes until thick and spongy.
Gently heat the bloomed gelatine — about 10–15 seconds in the microwave or over a warm pan — just until fully dissolved. Let it cool slightly.
In a large bowl, beat cream cheese and condensed milk together until completely smooth.
Fold the cooled gelatine into the cream cheese mixture until evenly combined.
Pour the filling over the prepared base and smooth the top. Refrigerate for 4–6 hours or overnight until fully set.

notes.title: Serving Tip
notes.content: Slice with a hot knife for clean edges. Dress it up with fresh berries, lemon zest, or a chocolate drizzle — or let the classic shine as is.

notes.title: Gelatine Blooming
notes.content: Sprinkle gelatine over cold water, let it bloom for 5 minutes, then gently heat until dissolved. Never add dry gelatine directly to the mixture. See the Gelatine Blooming Guide for full details.
